<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="15" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="13" x2="331" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="11" x2="336" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="383" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <g>
    <polyline points="25,57 17,65 25,73" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <rect x="43" y="58" width="177" height="14" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>

    <text x="331" y="69" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <line x1="18" y1="88" x2="372" y2="88" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- lesson context -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="117" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">LESSON 3 OF 5</text>
    <text x="20" y="147" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Translate the sentence</text>
    <circle cx="357" cy="140" r="16" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="351,135 356,135 361,140 356,145 351,145" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="355" y1="132" x2="355" y2="148" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- artwork card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="167" width="354" height="151" rx="14" fill="#6F6F70" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="18" y="165" width="354" height="151" rx="14" fill="#D1EBF7"/>

    <rect x="19" y="244" width="352" height="71" rx="0" fill="#6195D3" opacity="0.48"/>
    <ellipse cx="78" cy="225" rx="70" ry="29" fill="#9DAD88" opacity="0.6"/>

    <polygon points="174,267 220,203 267,267" fill="#15451F" opacity="0.38"/>
    <polygon points="279,267 322,220 355,267" fill="#9DAD88" opacity="0.72"/>

    <circle cx="63" cy="192" r="5" fill="#F3AD6D"/>
    <circle cx="139" cy="249" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
    <polygon points="139,249 150,244 146,255 133,257 128,249" fill="#D84F9E"/>
    <circle cx="290" cy="236" r="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <polygon points="290,236 301,231 297,243 284,245 279,236" fill="#D84F9E"/>
    <circle cx="242" cy="275" r="4" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <circle cx="249" cy="279" r="3" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <text x="32" y="190" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">A moment in art</text>
    <text x="32" y="207" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#15451F">Water Lilies · Claude Monet</text>
  </g>

  <!-- source sentence -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="349" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French</text>
    <text x="20" y="377" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Les fleurs flottent sur l'eau.</text>
    <circle cx="349" cy="369" r="18" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <polygon points="344,364 348,364 353,369 348,374 344,374" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="361" x2="348" y2="377" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- answer area -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="414" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Your answer</text>
    <rect x="18" y="426" width="354" height="91" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="481" x2="356" y2="481" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="35" y="462" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Tap the words below to translate</text>
    <text x="35" y="502" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">The flowers</text>
    <rect x="142" y="487" width="111" height="33" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="157" y="509" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">float</text>
    <rect x="260" y="487" width="88" height="33" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="274" y="509" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">on</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="538" width="104" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="40" y="567" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">the</text>
    <rect x="132" y="538" width="108" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="153" y="567" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">water</text>
    <rect x="250" y="538" width="122" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="270" y="567" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">flowers</text>
    <rect x="18" y="595" width="86" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="37" y="624" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">float</text>
    <rect x="114" y="595" width="82" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="139" y="624" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">on</text>
    <rect x="206" y="595" width="87" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="229" y="624" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">the</text>
    <rect x="303" y="595" width="69" height="46" rx="13" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <text x="321" y="624" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- hint and continue -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="34" cy="670" r="14" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <text x="30" y="676" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">?</text>
    <text x="57" y="676" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Need a hint?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="694" width="354" height="48" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
      <text x="195" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CHECK</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->

      <rect x="42" y="782" width="20" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="52" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">HOME</text>
    </g>

      <text x="136" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">LEARN</text>
    </g>
    <!-- leaderboard -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="204,798 204,783 212,783 212,790 220,790 220,776 228,776 228,798" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="216" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">RANK</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="306" cy="780" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="306" cy="797" rx="13" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="306" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <line x1="150" y1="839" x2="240" y2="839" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
